<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ricky's 40th Golf Weekend</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,900;1,700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@300;400;500&family=Bebas+Neue&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --bg: #1C1C1C;
    --bg-card: #242424;
    --bg-subtle: #2A2A2A;
    --accent: #8B9E7A;
    --accent-light: #A8BA98;
    --gold: #B8A882;
    --gold-light: #CFC0A0;
    --text-primary: #F0EDE8;
    --text-secondary: #B8B4AC;
    --text-muted: #7A7670;
    --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }

  body {
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  /* HERO */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 80px 40px 60px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #1C1C1C;
  }
  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
  }
  .logo-top {
    position: absolute; top: 28px; right: 36px;
    width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden;
    opacity: 0; animation: fadeIn 0.8s ease 0.1s forwards;
  }
  .logo-top img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

  .hero-badge {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 6px;
    color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(139,158,122,0.4);
    padding: 5px 18px; margin-bottom: 36px;
    opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.2s forwards;
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(48px, 9vw, 90px);
    font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; color: var(--text-primary);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.4s forwards;
    letter-spacing: -1px;
  }
  .hero-title span { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }
  .hero-sub {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 22px);
    font-style: italic; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 48px;
    font-weight: 300;
    opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.6s forwards;
  }
  .hero-meta {
    display: flex; gap: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;
    opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.8s forwards;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .meta-item {
    text-align: center; padding: 16px 28px;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .meta-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .meta-label {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 4px;
    color: var(--accent); display: block; margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .meta-value { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 400; }

  .divider {
    width: 40px; height: 1px;
    background: var(--accent);
    margin: 50px auto; opacity: 0.5;
  }

  /* SECTIONS */
  .section { padding: 60px 40px; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .section-label {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 5px;
    color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 8px; opacity: 0.8;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 40px);
    font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 32px; color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  .section-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--gold); }

  /* SCHEDULE */
  .schedule-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .schedule-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
    padding: 28px 24px;
  }
  .day-label {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 4px;
    color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .course-name {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .course-detail { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .tee-time { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gold); margin-top: 12px; }
  .course-pills { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
  .pill {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--text-muted); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 2px 8px;
  }

  /* HIRE TABLE */
  .hire-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 16px; }
  .hire-table th {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--accent); text-align: left; padding: 8px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .hire-table td {
    padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .hire-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

  /* INCLUDES */
  .includes-bg { background: var(--bg); padding: 60px 40px; }
  .includes-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 24px; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .include-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; }
  .include-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(139,158,122,0.3);
    border-radius: 2px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 14px; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .include-text strong {
    display: block; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .include-text span { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; }

  /* PHOTOS */
  .photo-full { width: 100%; margin-top: 24px; overflow: hidden; }
  .photo-full img { width: 100%; max-height: 260px; object-fit: cover; display: block; filter: brightness(0.9); }

  /* ROOM FEATURES */
  .room-features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; }
  .room-feat {
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); padding-left: 14px;
    position: relative; line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .room-feat::before { content: '—'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--accent); font-size: 10px; top: 2px; }

  /* DINING */
  .dining-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .dining-item {
    background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-left: 2px solid var(--accent); padding: 14px 16px;
  }
  .dining-item strong {
    display: block; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 2px;
    font-size: 11px; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .dining-item span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

  /* MENU */
  .menu-section { padding: 60px 40px; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .menu-courses { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; margin-top: 28px; }
  .menu-course {
    background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); padding: 24px 20px;
  }
  .menu-course-title {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 4px;
    color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 18px; padding-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .menu-item { margin-bottom: 14px; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .menu-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; margin-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .menu-item-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .menu-item-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic; line-height: 1.4; }
  .menu-tags { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .menu-tag {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(139,158,122,0.3); padding: 1px 5px;
  }
  .menu-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center; }

  /* FOOTER */
  .footer {
    background: #161616 !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 50px 40px; text-align: center;
  }
  .footer-logo { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; margin: 0 auto 20px; opacity: 0.9; }
  .footer-logo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  .footer-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 22px; font-style: italic; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .footer-address { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .footer-web { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); }
  .footer-credit { margin-top: 28px; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 4px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .footer-qr { margin: 28px auto 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 48px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .footer-qr-item { text-align: center; }
  .footer-qr-item img {
    width: 100px; height: 100px; object-fit: cover;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); display: block; margin: 0 auto 8px;
    filter: invert(1);
  }
  .footer-qr-label { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--text-muted); }

  /* CANCELLATION */
  .cancel-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
  .cancel-item { background: var(--bg-subtle); padding: 6px 10px; text-align: center; border-left: 2px solid var(--accent); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .cancel-period { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-muted); display: block; }
  .cancel-pct { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .schedule-grid, .room-features { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .logo-top { width: 64px; height: 64px; top: 16px; right: 16px; }
    .meta-item { padding: 12px 16px; }
    .hero-meta { flex-direction: column; border: none; gap: 0; }
    .meta-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  }
  
  @media print {
    * { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important; print-color-adjust: exact !important; color-adjust: exact !important; }
  }

  
  /* A4 PAGE FORMAT */
  @page {
    size: A4;
    margin: 0;
  }

  html {
    width: 210mm;
  }

  body {
    width: 210mm;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* Page break hints */
  .section, .menu-section, .includes-bg {
    page-break-inside: avoid;
  }

  /* Fix hero to A4 page height */
  .hero {
    min-height: 0 !important;
    padding: 60px 50px 50px !important;
  }


  @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="logo-top"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="The Travel Collective"></div>
  <div class="hero-badge">A Weekend to Remember</div>
  <h1 class="hero-title">Ricky's<br><span>40th</span></h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">Golf Weekend Getaway</p>
  <div class="hero-meta">
    <div class="meta-item"><span class="meta-label">Dates</span><span class="meta-value">9th – 10th May 2026</span></div>
    <div class="meta-item"><span class="meta-label">Location</span><span class="meta-value">Belton Woods Resort, Grantham</span></div>
    <div class="meta-item"><span class="meta-label">Golf</span><span class="meta-value">36 Holes of Championship Golf</span></div>
    <div class="meta-item"><span class="meta-label">Price</span><span class="meta-value">£269 per person</span></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- COURSES -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-label">The Courses</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Two Days,<br><em>Two Championship Courses</em></h2>
  <div class="schedule-grid">
    <div class="schedule-card">
      <div class="day-label">Saturday · Day One</div>
      <div class="course-name">Woods Course</div>
      <div class="course-detail">Par 73 · Yardage 6,623<br>A more forgiving woodland course — fairways and nature reward careful negotiation. Slightly more undulating than The Lakes, with a picturesque setting and on-site lodges.</div>
      <div class="tee-time">⛳ Tee times: 11:56 – 12:12</div>
    </div>
    <div class="schedule-card">
      <div class="day-label">Sunday · Day Two</div>
      <div class="course-name">Lakes Course</div>
      <div class="course-detail">Par 72 · Yardage 4,776<br>A real test for players — lakes guard approaches to many greens. Holes are long, fairways tight. The 9th hole is over 600 yards. Course management is key.</div>
      <div class="tee-time">⛳ Tee times: 12:20 – 12:36</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>
<!-- HIRE -->
<section class="section" style="padding-top:0;">
  <div class="section-label">Equipment</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Hire <em>Items</em></h2>
  <table class="hire-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Cost</th><th>Notes</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>Buggy</td><td>£50 each</td><td>5 booked, 1 pending</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Electric Trolley</td><td>£20 each</td><td>Subject to availability</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Push Trolley</td><td>£5 each</td><td>Subject to availability</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</section>

<!-- PACKAGE INCLUDES -->
<div class="includes-bg">
  <div class="section" style="padding-top:0;padding-bottom:0;">
    <div class="section-label">The Package</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Everything <em>Included</em></h2>
    <div class="includes-grid">
      <div class="include-item"><div class="include-icon">⛳</div><div class="include-text"><strong>Golf</strong><span>36 holes across two championship courses</span></div></div>
      <div class="include-item"><div class="include-icon">🛏</div><div class="include-text"><strong>Accommodation</strong><span>1 night Superior Twin Room upgrade</span></div></div>
      <div class="include-item"><div class="include-icon">🍽</div><div class="include-text"><strong>Dining</strong><span>3-course dinner (£30 allowance) & full English breakfast</span></div></div>
      <div class="include-item"><div class="include-icon">🥂</div><div class="include-text"><strong>Drinks Discount</strong><span>10% off drinks via room key throughout stay</span></div></div>
      <div class="include-item"><div class="include-icon">💆</div><div class="include-text"><strong>Spa Access</strong><span>Full use of the resort spa facilities</span></div></div>
      <div class="include-item"><div class="include-icon">📶</div><div class="include-text"><strong>Room Amenities</strong><span>Tea/coffee, blackout curtains, TV, safe & free Wi-Fi</span></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- ACCOMMODATION -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-label">Your Room</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Superior <em>Twin Room</em></h2>
  <p style="font-size:15px;color:#B8B4AC;line-height:1.7;font-weight:400;">Generously sized rooms with two inviting double beds, plump pillows and cosy feather duvets. In-room extras include bathrobes, a selection of complimentary drinks and indulgent toiletries in the spacious bathroom.</p>
  <div class="room-features">
    <div class="room-feat">Two Double Beds</div>
    <div class="room-feat">En-Suite Bathroom</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Nespresso Coffee Machine</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Access to Health Club</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Free Parking</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Free Wi-Fi</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Shower over Bath</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Enhanced Toiletries</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Towels & Bathrobes</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Blackout Curtains</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Mini Fridge</div>
    <div class="room-feat">Air Conditioned</div>
  </div>
  <div class="photo-full"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Superior Twin Room"></div>
</section>

<!-- CHECK-IN -->
<section class="section" style="padding-top:0;">
  <div class="section-label">Timings</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Arrival &amp; <em>Departure</em></h2>
  <div class="dining-row" style="margin-top:0;">
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Check-In</strong><span>From 3:00pm on Saturday</span></div>
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Check-Out</strong><span>By 11:00am on Sunday</span></div>
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Single Supplement</strong><span>£70 per night</span></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- DINING -->
<section class="section" style="padding-top:0;">
  <div class="section-label">Food &amp; Drink</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Dining &amp; <em>Refreshments</em></h2>
  <div class="dining-row">
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Dinner</strong><span>3-course meal with £30 allowance</span></div>
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Arrival Bacon Rolls</strong><span>£7 per person</span></div>
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Lunch</strong><span>From £15 per person</span></div>
    <div class="dining-item"><strong>Private Dining</strong><span>£10 per person supplement</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="photo-full"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Resort Dining"></div>
</section>


<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- DINNER MENU -->
<div style="page-break-before: always;"></div>
<section class="menu-section" style="page-break-inside: avoid;">
  <div class="section-label">Saturday Evening</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Group Golf <em>Dinner Menu</em></h2>
  <p style="font-size:15px;color:#B8B4AC;line-height:1.7;font-weight:400;">The <strong style="color:var(--gold-light)">6-6-6 Challenge</strong> — choose one starter, one main and one dessert from the selection below. Included within your £30 dinner allowance.</p>

  <div class="menu-courses">

    <div class="menu-course">
      <div class="menu-course-title">Starters</div>

      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Roasted Red Pepper &amp; Tomato Soup</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Balsamic glaze and herb croutons</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">VE</span><span class="menu-tag">GF</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Smoked Mackerel Fillet</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Potato, beetroot and horseradish salad</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">GF</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Greek Salad</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Balsamic syrup and pitta bread shards</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">VEA</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Classic Prawn Cocktail</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Marie-rose sauce and rye bread</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">GFA</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Chicken Liver Terrine</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Toasted brioche and onion chutney</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">GFA</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Pressed Ham Hock Terrine</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Piccalilli and sourdough bread</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">GFA</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="menu-course">
      <div class="menu-course-title">Main Course</div>

      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Pumpkin &amp; Sage Tortellini</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Toasted pumpkin seeds, hard cheese shavings, crispy sage and onion</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">VE</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Mediterranean Roasted Vegetable Gnocchi</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Tomato and coriander sauce</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">VE</span><span class="menu-tag">GFA</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Hake Fillet</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Tomato orzo, mediterranean vegetables and red pepper sauce</div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Roast Salmon</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Crushed new potatoes, green vegetables and chive hollandaise</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">GF</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Steak and Ale Pie</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Creamy mash potato, confit carrot, green beans and thyme gravy</div>
      </div>
      <div class="menu-item">
        <div class="menu-item-name">Breast of Chicken</div>
        <div class="menu-item-desc">Garlic dauphinoise potatoes, confit carrot and thyme jus</div>
        <div class="menu-tags"><span class="menu-tag">GF</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="menu-course">
      <div class="menu-course-title">Desserts</div>

      <div class="menu-item">
